table.name: employee
table.purpose: Master list of employees with basic personal attributes; referenced by hiring and evaluation records. (Note: names and cities are English rugby players/clubs, suggesting disguised or sample data.)

City.name: city
City.description: City associated with the employee; values are English rugby club locations (Bath, Bristol, Leicester, Sale, Wasps).

Employee_ID.name: employee_id
Employee_ID.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each employee; referenced by hiring.Employee_ID and evaluation.Employee_ID.

Name.name: full_name
Name.description: Employee's full name (e.g. 'Lee Mears'); all values unique.

table.name: evaluation
table.purpose: Yearly bonus awards per employee; an employee can receive bonuses in multiple years.

Bonus.name: bonus_amount
Bonus.description: Bonus amount awarded, in currency units (range 2900-4000).

Employee_ID.name: employee_id
Employee_ID.description: Foreign key to employee.Employee_ID identifying the employee who received the bonus.

Year_awarded.name: year_awarded
Year_awarded.description: Calendar year in which the bonus was awarded (2011-2018).

table.name: hiring
table.purpose: Employment details per employee: which shop they work at, since when, and whether full-time.

Employee_ID.name: employee_id
Employee_ID.description: Foreign key to employee.Employee_ID; one row per employee (one_to_one with employee).

Is_full_time.name: is_full_time
Is_full_time.description: Whether the employee works full time; 'T' = true, 'F' = false.

Shop_ID.name: shop_id
Shop_ID.description: Foreign key to shop.Shop_ID identifying the shop where the employee was hired/works.

table.name: shop
table.purpose: Master list of shops/outlets with location, manager and product count. (Data appears to be Finnish football clubs, likely disguised sample data.)

District.name: district
District.description: Name of the district/venue where the shop is located; values are Finnish stadium names (e.g. 'Finnair Stadium').

Location.name: location_city
Location.description: City where the shop is located (Finnish cities: Helsinki, Espoo, Turku, etc.).

Manager_name.name: manager_name
Manager_name.description: Full name of the shop's manager.

Name.name: shop_name
Name.description: Name of the shop; values are Finnish football club names (e.g. 'HJK', 'FC Inter').

Number_products.name: number_products
Number_products.description: Count of products stocked/sold by the shop (range 1600-15000).

Shop_ID.name: shop_id
Shop_ID.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each shop; referenced by hiring.Shop_ID.
